title: Dealer checks and fault bookings
summary: Reviews in this topic center on reporting faults to dealers, having vehicles checked, and booking visits to investigate or sort issues, with many fragments lacking enough context to judge the outcome.

positive.summary: One positive review says the dealer checked the reported issue and did not find a fault.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe persistent or unresolved faults that were booked in for inspection or remained unexplained after dealer checks.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mainly mention checking with the dealer or booking the vehicle in, but do not provide enough context about the issue or result.

limitations: Most fragments are very short or procedural, so the sample often does not reveal the underlying problem or whether it was resolved.
This cluster includes both dealer confirmation/checking language and unresolved fault descriptions, so the topic is operationally related but not fully specific to one single issue.
